title: SUMERAIN S1421-BN Single-Handle Bathroom Faucet, Brushed Nickel

comparisons.notes: SUMERAIN S1421-BN brushed nickel single-hole faucet with supply hoses

amazon_match_notes: Amazon lists SUMERAIN S1421-BN brushed nickel single-handle faucet, same as Woot's ASIN
writeup: SUMERAIN's S1421-BN is a single-hole bathroom faucet with a 304 stainless steel body, brushed nickel finish, ceramic cartridge and 1.2 GPM flow, and it comes with supply lines (no pop-up drain). Home Depot sells it for $44.62.
